verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents headless, programmatic operation. It offers Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs, an API alongside the UI for trace operations, environment-variable-based tracing, and dataset experiments run to catch regressions. That supports scripted, non-interactive use, but nothing explicitly documents CI integration or a CLI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g., running evals in GitHub Actions or failing builds on regressions), an official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
